title: Breton Buckwheat Galette Batter
ingredients: 500g buckwheat flour (blé noir), ideally IGP Bretagne
1L water at room temperature (500ml on day 1 + 500ml on day 2)
1 tbsp honey (optional, for colour and crispness)
Lard for the griddle (or coconut oil for a vegan version)

title: Browned Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 210g browned butter (from approximately one 250g block of unsalted butter)

title: Cannelés Bordelais
ingredients: 150g T80 organic flour (or whole wheat/all-purpose flour)
Slider release agent for greasing molds

title: Bakwan (Indonesian Veggie Pancakes)
ingredients: A pinch of salt (skip it if you use normal soy sauce)

title: Hyderabadi Kacchi Chicken Dum Biryani
ingredients: 900 g bone-in chicken, cut into large pieces
250 g plain full-fat yogurt, whisked smooth
120 g bawang goreng (ready-fried onions or shallots)
500 g basmati rice, aged if possible
1 tsp kewra water or rose water (optional)

title: Japanese Fluffy Sponge Cake
ingredients: 6 eggs (whites and yolks separated), at room temperature
A few drops of lemon juice or white vinegar
